messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team, prepping for SOC2 fieldwork next week. Need a mapping that links RBAC change events (k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding + IAM policy changes) to any KMS decrypt/unseal operations during a 72h incident window (2025-03-14 00:00 UTC - 2025-03-17 00:00 UTC). Specifically: how to correlate who changed RBAC -> which service account used what key to decrypt, and chain-of-custody artifacts. Can you provide queries + an exported signed bundle?

maria: Sure. Quick q: do you need cloud provider CMKs only or also HSM/EKM logs? Also do you want per-region exports or a single consolidated bundle? :thinking:

auditor_jane: CMKs first, HSM/EKM if available. Region: all prod regions. Chain-of-custody: prefer signed manifest + SHA256 for bundles.

maria: OK. Plan: 1) export k8s audit trail for RBAC changes (prod clusters) + CloudTrail for IAM/KMS. 2) correlate by time proximity and token issuer to map RBAC actor -> service-principal -> KMS Decrypt. 3) produce signed manifest (manifest.json.sig) and upload to s3. I'll include Splunk queries and an export link.

tom: For KMS decrypts, look for CloudTrail eventName=Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt. For cross-account decrypts check userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer. Wrapped key flows show ReEncrypt/Decrypt pairs.

maria: Sample Splunk query (prod indexes):
```spl
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt)
| rex field=userIdentity.accountId as acct
| eval ts=_time
| table ts, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.ciphertext
| sort ts
```
I'll also pull k8s audit:
```spl
index=k8s_audit (verb=patch OR verb=update OR verb=create OR verb=bind)
| table _time, verb, user.username, objectRef.resource, objectRef.name, requestObject
```
Then we'll join on time proximity +/- 5m and token issuer.

lisa: Compliance note: please map each artifact to SOC2 CC6.1.2 and ISO A.9.4 entries. Include a short control mapping doc with artifact IDs.

maria: Exported bundle is staged (staged, unsigned) at: s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1833333333-rbac-kms-bundle.zip. It will contain cloudtrail.csv, k8s_audit.csv, join_mappings.csv, manifest.json (and we'll produce manifest.json.sig after signing). Placeholder SHA256: abcdef1234567890... (real hash will be added after signing).

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2025-03-15T02:17Z - brief outage: autoscaler rollback triggered. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20250315-2

auditor_jane: Good — please ensure the autoscaler incident ID is included in the mapping rows. Also: need who initiated RBAC rollbacks and whether any emergency/ephemeral keys were used.

maria: Confirmed. For ephemeral keys, we have aliases like alias/ephemeral/* — include Decrypt/ReEncrypt events for those aliases. Note retention windows: CloudTrail 180 days, k8s_audit 90 days for prod cluster. We'll provide raw exports and a redacted copy (PII removed) for the auditor.

tom: I'll run the export this afternoon and produce the signed manifest. Command I run to upload and sign (example):
```bash
aws s3 cp ./1833333333-rbac-kms-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/temp/ && \
aws kms sign --key-id alias/signing-key --message fileb://manifest.json --signature fileb://manifest.json.sig
aws s3 mv s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1833333333-rbac-kms-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1833333333-rbac-kms-bundle.zip
```

auditor_jane: ETA for signed bundle?

maria: ETA ~6 hours. If anything blocks I'll DM you. We'll also include a CSV with correlation_score per row and the rule that derived it.

auditor_jane: Please also include guidance on how you computed correlation_score (weights: time proximity, token issuer match, matching IP/user-agent, service-account annotation).

maria: Will include the scoring doc. Attaching the pseudo-SQL join I'll run and the final column set: rbacs_time, rbacs_actor, rbacs_object, rbacs_change_type, kms_time, kms_actor, key_id, key_alias, correlation_score, incident_id, manifest_ref.

auditor_jane: One last ask: provide a small sanitized example row so we can see the chainproof format.

maria: Example sanitized row (sanitized emails + truncated ids):
rbac_1715801020 | alice@redwood | RoleBinding:prod-autoscaler | patch | kms_1715801048 | svc-account-autoscaler | key/1234-uuid | alias/ephemeral/autoscaler | 0.92 | INC-20250315-2 | s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1833333333/manifest.json.sig

auditor_jane: Perfect. We'll review and reply with any follow-ups after the bundle arrives. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
